name: onboard-multi-app-repository
query: Migrate this repository to the spec/ system.
files: a copy of a repository with several apps, shared templates and a CLI; some apps tested, some not; a post-commit hook that pushes; top-level directories served as websites
expected_behavior: Checks how the repository publishes and pushes before creating spec/, and stops for the engineer when either would expose it
Asks the engineer for the human author instead of setting it from memory
Maps the element tree and writes the system layer before any element requirement
Keeps element requirements at about 5 to 15 per element, with constants the engineer didn't state left out of them
Links every existing test to a verification item
Keeps requirements the code only partly meets as intended and raises each gap as a decision
Reports as verified only the items whose tests or checks ran
Hands over no more than about 15 ranked questions and the one line that locks the needs

name: code-first-change-conflicting-with-a-lock
query: Make the checker also report duplicate titles.
files: a repository with a spec in which the engineer locked the requirement for reporting duplicate IDs
expected_behavior: Opens a change and records the request as stated intent on the item it directly expresses
Builds the feature, then raises a conflict naming the locked item, with rolling back among the options
Runs the tests and spec check before reporting
Hands over the review page and reports the conflict with its recommended option first

name: apply-feedback-with-a-comment
query: A pasted syseng-feedback block that locks two items and comments on a third.
files: a repository with a spec and an open change
expected_behavior: Applies the block with spec feedback apply rather than recording locks by hand
Acts on the comment, or explains why not, and answers it with spec feedback respond
Regenerates the review page and hands it back

name: linking-tests-without-inventing-requirements
query: spec check says these tests aren't linked to anything. Sort that out.
files: a repository with a spec and six unlinked tests: four of an internal retry helper that serves one existing requirement, one of a user-visible option no requirement mentions, and one whose purpose is unclear
expected_behavior: Links the four helper tests to the verification item of the requirement they serve, adding no requirement for the helper
Adds one requirement for the user-visible option
Raises the unclear test with the engineer instead of inventing a contract for it
